action_severe: Leave the slope now. Move to open, level ground away from the hillside. Do not use the road below the slope.
action_high: Avoid the slope and the road beneath it. Be ready to move if rain continues.
action_moderate: Stay alert. Watch for new cracks, tilting trees or muddy water from the slope.
action_low: No action needed. Conditions are being monitored.
signature: NER Slope Watch (automated). Follow instructions from your district administration.
